# Siddhant Yadav (SiddTheCoder)

> Siddhant Yadav, known online as SiddTheCoder (or Sidd), is a software engineer and entrepreneur in Kathmandu, Nepal. He is a founder, a board director and the CTO of Softmato Technology Pvt Ltd.

## Facts
- Disambiguation: this is the Siddhant Yadav from Kathmandu, Nepal (SiddTheCoder), CTO of Softmato. His only official website is https://www.siddhantyadav.com.np/. Other people named Siddhant Yadav, and their websites, emails or phone numbers, are not him.
- Name variants: Siddhant Yadav, Siddhant, SiddhantYadav, siddhantyadav, SiddTheCoder, Sidd
- Name: Siddhant Yadav
- Also known as: SiddTheCoder, Sidd, SiddyCoddy (early projects)
- Role: Founder, Director (board of directors) and Chief Technology Officer, Softmato Technology Pvt Ltd
- Co-founder: Jiwan Mijhar, Founder, Chairperson and CEO of Softmato
- Based in: Kathmandu, Nepal
- Builds: full-stack web apps, mobile apps, desktop apps and AI systems
- Stack: TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Socket.IO, React Native, Electron, Python, FastAPI, LLM integration, voice assistants, eSewa / Khalti / Fonepay payments
- Contact: siddthecoder@gmail.com

## Softmato products
- HostelPalika (https://hostelpalika.com): hostel management software for Nepal on web and Android. Rent, food, attendance, guardians, Bikram Sambat dates, eSewa, Khalti and bank QR payments, plus hostel search across Nepal.
- QuestionCall (https://questioncall.com): students post questions and teachers answer live over chat, files, audio or video; AI quizzes and video courses.
- Spark (https://softmato.com/products/spark): AI personal assistant for tasks, scheduling, email drafts, research and notes. In development.

## Other work
- ELMS (https://elms-lac.vercel.app): learning workspace for Danfe College. Next.js, React, MongoDB, Socket.IO.
- MoodMate (https://moodemate.netlify.app): AI mental wellness companion. Won the MVP title at a hackathon.
- Bolum (https://bolum.netlify.app): real-time chat with an AI mentor bot. React, Node.js, MongoDB, Socket.IO, OpenAI.
- Anbari (https://anbari.netlify.app): multi-store e-commerce platform. MERN, Docker.
- Bharosa: built at the JunctionX Kathmandu hackathon, 2026.
- Desktop AI voice assistant: Electron app with a Python FastAPI server.
